title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ! ORGANIZING CERTAIN BARRIOS OF THE MUNICI PALITY OF LEMERY, PROVINCE OF BATAN- GAS, INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNICIPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF PANSIPIT.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
The municipality of Pansipit as herein organized shall
consist of that portion of the municipality of Lemery,
Province of Batangas, which is separated from the rest of
the territory of the said municipality of Lemery by the
following boundary:
From a point where the waters of Lake Taal and the Pansipit
River meet, going approximately southward, then southwestward,
following the course of the Pansipit River to where this river meets
the course of the stream locally known as Balangon; thence upstream
follcwing the course of Balangon Stream to its sorce somewhere on
the slope of the ridge locally known as Balangon Ridge, which is
a visible landmark separating the barrio of Balangon in the north
from the barrio of Ayaoiyao in the south; thence following the Ba-
langon Ridge in a more or less northwest direction to where it slopes
down to the dry creek locally known as Kailong Creek; thence fol-
lowing the bed of this dry creek in a more or less north direction
to the ridge locally known as Binigtal Ridge; thence in a more or
less north direction, following this ridge to where it intersects the
present boundary line between the municipality of Talisay and the
municipality of Lemery, both of the Province of Batangas.
The municipality of Lemery shall consist of its present
territory minus the area comprised in the municipality of
This organization shall take effect on July 1, 1948.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of May, in the
year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and forty-eight, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the second.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
